review_state: production rev 1 - M1, awaiting owner look review
purpose: Creature stage nest (PROPOSED): a ring mound of packed earth and straw, heaped unevenly, with twigs and stones across it, round a clear flat floor where the creature stands.

textures.name: T_CreatureNestRing_Albedo
textures.packing: greyscale albedo detail (baked AO darkens crevices), times each material's base colour

textures.name: T_CreatureNestRing_ORM
textures.packing: R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic

pivot: the nest's centre on the ground (Godot y = 0)

reduction.method: Blender collapse decimation within a surface tolerance; full-detail shading baked to the normal map

provenance: Authored procedurally in Blender by tools/blender/make_creature_world.py; no external or generated meshes. Textures baked in Blender from procedural shaders; the field tiles are periodic sine sums and wrapped Voronoi in numpy, so they repeat without seams.
